Located on [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="db">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a '''village''' was the home of [[Sunchoo]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="Jedi" /> Sometime in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCW">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'' takes place after the start of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] apprenticeship to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Sunchoo was kidnapped from this village by [[Crovan Dane]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Later, Sunchoo was freed by [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngling]] [[Jaylen Kos]] and [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]], and, after searching for Dane in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of Kashyyyk, returned to the village to celebrate.<ref name="Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The village's only appearance to date is in the [[2008]] young reader's [[List of books|book]], ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'', written by [[Jake Forbes]]. Since the book is a Decide Your Destiny book, there are many different outcomes for the situations featured within. However, Sunchoo's village only appears in one of these story strands, so this article uses that one.<ref name="Jedi" />
